customManagers.description: Tool versions pinned as literals inside workflows (promtool, yq, gitleaks). The github-actions manager only sees `uses:` refs and container images — a version baked into a download URL or a workflow input default is invisible to it, so it silently rots.

prek hook revs (prek.toml) — inline renovate comments (datasource=github-tags). No manager understands prek/pre-commit TOML, so without this the hook pins only move when someone remembers to run `prek autoupdate`.

packageRules.description: Self-references (`KevinDeBenedetti/github-workflows/...@main`) are this very repo — a PR pinning them would be noise, and @main is deliberate for internal composite actions.
These versions are stored WITHOUT the leading v (the download URL adds it back), while the upstream tags carry it — strip it so comparisons work.
promtool and yq are installed by the same step in ci-prometheus.yml — one PR, one review.
